name: Elmin Kanan
source:
Kukul's younger brother. Despite being male, he has potential as a Miko of the Divine Beast, a rarity on Palastra. As he was raised in an environment cut off from the outside world, he has a very naive and innocent demeanor. His slender form and pretty look gives off the impression of a woman, and he is often described as being feminine and cute.

[From the [url=https://ninetail.info/CF/VenusBloodGAIA_International/en18_character.html]official website[/url]]
